plan.rationale: Mathematical assumption: both tip-speed weights enter the frozen gvs_nmpc@7.0.0 objective as squared world tip speed normalized by the fixed tip_speed_scale_m_s, while acceptance is a sampled threshold test over six samples in [0.30,0.35] s, so the weight-to-acceptance map is nonconvex and local; explicit finite points are enumeration, not mathematical optimization, and no gradient, affine or surrogate model is used or claimed. Support and capability limits: only the two granted continuous control paths are legal in control_search, discrete design/material paths are excluded here, and M5 retained prediction evidence has no screening authority. Allocation: hold holding_tip_speed_weight at the incumbent 0.05 and vary only terminal_tip_speed_weight over the granted [0.025,0.10] with the two ordered points 0.10 then 0.025; each point plus the unchanged incumbent reference is rebuilt from the retained source batch-ebbeadbdaca10732-0 and executed once as one complete v7 closed loop on nominal seed 17, giving a same-condition incumbent-versus-candidate comparison with no inner search and no extra control budget. Expected information: whether terminal weight moves sampled holding_max_speed_m_s at fixed holding weight, whether a fresh nominal joint pass with an effective incumbent-relative control change is obtained, and the sign and size of any terminal/margin tradeoff; both values are previously untested points, so no matching-point replication_reason is required. Counterevidence and honest risks: three imported in-domain increases of holding_tip_speed_weight at terminal 0.05 (0.06, 0.075, 0.09) each failed holding speed (0.02260458517372844, 0.023285947509969908, 0.023994623331658485 m/s), the unique in-domain joint pass (0.09, 0.10) is confounded across two weights and is a tradeoff, the zero-holding-weight pass (0.0, 0.05) is outside the granted domain, and a changed near-section-scale candidate failed holding speed on near_z_plus; a nil or negative result is therefore a live outcome. This batch does not establish the unchanged incumbent's perturbed robustness and does not establish repeatability. Exit criteria: stop on any material failure, reservation shortfall or request/correction ceiling, or on voluntary STOP; only a fresh complete correctly bound nominal joint pass with no physical metric worsening (tradeoffs retain the incumbent) may later be taken forward to perturbed cases.

plan.rationale: Mathematical assumption: the two control tip-speed weights enter the frozen gvs_nmpc@7.0.0 objective as squared world tip speed normalized by the fixed tip_speed_scale_m_s, while acceptance is a sampled threshold test over six samples in [0.30,0.35] s, so the weight-to-acceptance map is nonconvex and local; similarly the section-scale-to-acceptance map is a nonsmooth sampled map with no closed form. Explicit finite enumeration of two bounded numeric points is deliberate exploration, not mathematical optimization; no gradient, affine or surrogate model is used or claimed. Support and capability limits: only physical design paths and the two control paths are legal here; near_section_scale is a granted, technically supported continuous path whose incumbent value is 0.95 at the lower bound (so only the upward direction 1.00 and 1.05 is reachable), discrete material paths are left unused here, and M5 retained prediction evidence has no screening authority. Expected information: whether restoring/increasing near section scale yields a fresh nominal joint pass, in which direction each physical metric moves, and whether a structural change can achieve strictly non-worsening metrics where the control axes could not. Counterevidence and honest risks: the only executed structural change (near_section_scale 0.96) failed sampled holding speed on near_z_plus, and because it was perturbed and confounded it neither proves nor rules out that this axis can help; a nil or negative result at both points is a live outcome. Exit criteria: stop on any material failure, reservation shortfall or request/correction ceiling, or on voluntary STOP; only a fresh complete correctly bound nominal joint pass with no physical metric worsening (trade-offs retain the incumbent) may later be taken forward to perturbed cases.
